# OpenAPPA parity fixtures

These SCAD sources and binary STL reference meshes are copied from
`openappa-clean/website/public/brand` so the ReOpenSCAD parity suite does not
depend on a sibling checkout.

The reference meshes were generated by OpenSCAD and are test oracles only.
The production ReOpenSCAD server must not execute or link OpenSCAD.

Reference cases:

| Source | Definitions | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `openappa-fast-printing.scad` | none | `openappa-fast-printing.stl` |
| `openappa.scad` | `part="solid"` | `openappa-full-body.stl` |
| `openappa.scad` | `part="primary"` | `openappa-multi-color-part-1.stl` |
| `openappa.scad` | `part="secondary"` | `openappa-multi-color-part-2.stl` |
| `openappa-multipart.scad` | `part="body"` | `openappa-multipart-body.stl` |
| `openappa-multipart.scad` | `part="body_back"`, `print_orientation=true` | `openappa-multipart-body-back.stl` |
| `openappa-multipart.scad` | `part="body_front"`, `print_orientation=true` | `openappa-multipart-body-front.stl` |
| `openappa-multipart.scad` | `part="secondary"`, `print_orientation=true` | `openappa-multipart-gray.stl` |

The golden files intentionally live in the repository. Regenerating them is a
manual compatibility operation and is not part of normal test execution.
